svg.text: New-speaker amplitude response: speaker effects and dose family
C = SyncNet Sync-C; positive ΔC is a higher-score direction, not a speaker-level significance test.
Direction counts among complete pairs (n=20/20 planned): ΔC>0 14/20 (70.0%), ΔC<0 6/20 (30.0%), exact ΔC=0 0/20 (0.0%); missing 0/20 planned. Direction only.
Speaker-bootstrap percentile 95% CI for mean ΔC: +0.049 [-0.005, +0.106] · n=20/20
2 · Five planned evaluation levels relative to RAW_R1
Four nonzero-dose simultaneous 95% CIs are reused from the frozen analyzer; gray dots are speaker contrasts.
ΔC = C(dose) − C(RAW_R1); positive values indicate higher Sync-C
Evaluation baseline: per frozen protocol, each condition uses the same speaker’s original natural PCM as the evaluation audio.
FIXED’s measured per-sentence RMS dBFS is reported separately in p1_measured_audio_levels.svg / descriptive_metrics.csv.
All planned levels are shown; RAW_R1 is the zero reference, not a fifth contrast. No best dose is selected; the response is not forced to be monotonic.
